run_ode_gan_training: run the ODE GAN training script with configurable ODE mode, batch size, and dataset flags
run_model_function: run the GAN model forward pass to compute discriminator and generator gradients with regularization
update_model_function: update the GAN model weights by applying scaled discriminator and generator gradients via optimizers
compute_reg_grads: compute gradient penalty regularization by calculating the norm of generator gradients w.r.t. discriminator variables
copy_and_restore_vars: copy TensorFlow variables using tf.identity and restore them via assign ops for RK integration steps
